_provenance.status: PROVISIONAL — no frozen family API contract exists (see lib/api-client/family.ts)
_provenance.source: The office's own case sheet for the demo family, as the approved family-portal design records it (docs/08-delivery/family-portal-design/page-02-home.html · page-03-funeral.html).
note: WHAT THIS IS: the office's recorded arrangement for each loved one — the five moments the family portal's chain names (arrangement · viewing · funeral · burial · papers), each with the recorded instant or day, the place and the state. The staff case service (case-events-v1) has no family-facing read, so this is a provisional family fixture exactly like lib/fixtures/family/snapshot.json; live mode is not claimed and lib/api-client/family.ts::getFamilyCase is the only reader.

THE HOUSEHOLD SHAPE (captain, 2026-09-30): one account manages MANY loved ones, so `loved_ones[]` carries one recorded arrangement per person, keyed by the same `id` as snapshot.json and workspace.json.

WHERE THE FACTS COME FROM (pinned by tests/fixture-contract/family-case.test.ts): each arrangement instant and place cross-references that loved one's recorded office visit in lib/fixtures/family/workspace.json; the loved one's name is snapshot.json#loved_ones[].name; the burial place is the lot the loved one's plan names at the client's own park (lib/family/contact.ts#park); the viewing and funeral places and the days are the approved design sample's own recorded demo arrangement. The instants are true ISO instants (Asia/Manila) and render back to the design's own day and time labels through lib/family/family-view.ts.

NEVER INVENTED: no amount, no family-facing case number and no coordinator name appears — the office's case numbering and assignment are internal. A step the record does not carry is marked not_recorded and the page says so in a few words rather than guessing a time.
DEMO DATA ONLY: the family API has no live branch; a loved one whose record carries no case renders the honest 'not connected' state instead of a guessed schedule.
